title: Door signs.
officialText:
For the following buildings, signs shall be posted and maintained on exit stair doors in accordance with this section:
1. Buildings or portions thereof occupied by Group B or arranged to be occupied by more than 100 persons above or below the street level or more than 500 persons in the entire building.
2. High-rise buildings subject to Section 403
3. Buildings where any stair side door is locked pursuant to Section 1008.1.9.10.
Exception: Signs shall not be required on exit stair doors opening directly to dwelling or sleeping units in occupancy Group R where permitted by Section 1014.4.
